name: bobscheme_y_combinator_factorial

exports.name: start
exports.description: Runs the compiled Scheme top-level program and emits its write output through env.write_char/env.write_i32 imports.

tests.description: run the compiled Scheme program and assert its printed transcript
tests.notes: Builds factorial through the applicative-order Y combinator rather than a named recursive definition, then evaluates 8!.

source.description: Bob Scheme applicative-order Y combinator regression program, compiled with Bob's WasmGC backend.

toolchain.name: Bob Scheme WasmCompiler + wasm-tools + Binaryen
toolchain.command: PYTHONPATH=<bobscheme checkout> python3.13 examples/compile_to_wasm.py <source> | wasm-tools parse -o stage/<name>.wasm; ./scripts/prepare

description: Bob Scheme applicative-order Y combinator fixture exercising higher-order recursion, closures, multiplication, and tail-call-heavy dispatch.
notes: Bob is a real Scheme implementation whose WasmCompiler lowers Scheme expressions to core WebAssembly with GC-backed pairs, booleans, symbols, closures, environments, and function tables. The fixture asserts the program transcript through imported host print callbacks rather than a JavaScript launcher.
